clips.title: The story
paras: "What Is My Purpose?" is a quest centered on a giant Malfunctioning Cyclone Construct wandering aimlessly through agricultural fields. Repeating broken fragments of speech beneath its armor plating, the ancient machine has forgotten its original duties after decades of neglect following the departure of the wind elementals. Investigating the construct leads adventurers to consult local orchardist Aamelia Windfield to learn about its mysterious past and former caretakers.

Deep within the fields stands a towering Cyclone Construct, aimlessly pacing across the land while trapped in a broken operational loop. Those who approach the armored giant can hear muffled, fragmented speech vibrating from beneath its heavy plates, endlessly repeating errors and questioning its own fundamental function. Decades of isolation have left the machine hollow of purpose, its internal directives corrupted or forgotten. While towering and formidable in appearance, the automaton poses no active threat to passersby, existing instead as a melancholic relic of an older era whose voice has been reduced to static queries echoing over the soil.

When questioned about the machine, the local resident Aamelia Windfield reveals that the automaton has wandered the surrounding fields for decades, seemingly ever since the wind elementals departed. A local named Alvarion speculated that the machine once hauled bountiful harvests to distant markets or tended livestock centuries ago, long before the land was transformed into an orchard. In bygone ages, a group known as the Windshapers built and maintained these cyclone constructs. Although the orchard workers have occasionally discussed petitioning the Windshapers to repair the machine, the matter has never been urgent, leaving the construct to roam unbothered and largely ignored.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You lean in close to try and hear the words coming from beneath the giant construct's armor plates.
These fragmented words and phrases seem to just repeat. Maybe someone nearby knows more about this construct?

clips.title: Completion
paras: The construct? It's been wandering around the fields for decades. Since the wind elementals left us, I think. Alvarion suspected that it used to haul harvests to market, or maybe tend to livestock back before this was an orchard. That could have been a thousand years ago though.

In the old days, the Windshapers used to maintain these constructs. We've talked about petitioning them to come and take a look at it, but it's never been a pressing concern to us. Mostly we just ignore it these days.
